description: A PHP class for managing and retrieving available timezones, including functions for listing timezones, calculating user timezone from server environment, and converting timezone offsets.

classes.name: OX_Admin_Timezones
classes.description: Class providing methods to retrieve available timezones, calculate user timezone, and handle timezone configuration values.

methods.name: availableTimezones
methods.description: Returns an array of available timezones, optionally including a blank entry.

methods.name: getTimezone
methods.description: Returns the current default timezone of the server environment.

methods.name: getConfigTimezoneValue
methods.description: Determines the timezone value to write to configuration based on user selection and environment.

methods.name: _convertOffset
methods.description: Converts a timezone offset in milliseconds to a human-readable string (hours and minutes).
